runners_data.name: Seasmoke

races.paceDynamic: Pepite De Saphir will control proceedings from the front with Royal Maggs and It's Maisy tracking prominently behind. With only one confirmed pace-setter, Pepite De Saphir can dictate a measured tempo over this stamina-sapping 2m7½f trip without pressure. The hold-up runners Seasmoke and Strathcatcha will need the pace to collapse late to be competitive. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the steady pace and outstay the leader, with Royal Maggs and It's Maisy ideally positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays even and sustainable throughout
scenarios.body: Pepite De Saphir sets manageable fractions but lacks the finishing kick after 413 days off. The prominent runners can time their challenges perfectly and prove stronger in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Pepite De Saphir gets uncontested lead and quickens
scenarios.body: The Rebecca Menzies runner uses the lack of early pressure to build an unassailable advantage. Her class advantage tells despite the long absence and she holds off late challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Storms
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling early doors
scenarios.body: Seasmoke gets the perfect setup from his hold-up position as prominent runners go too slow. His consistent recent form and stamina kicks in as others tie up over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse All Round
scenarios.trigger: If Pepite De Saphir goes too fast early trying to use freshness
scenarios.body: The long absence tells and the leader burns out badly, while prominent trackers also suffer. Strathcatcha picks up the pieces despite her poor recent form and light weight advantage.

watchPoints.text: Pepite De Saphir's fitness after 413 days layoff - any early signs of rustiness could end her chances quickly
Royal Maggs for stamina fade in final furlong given her recent tendency to weaken close home
It's Maisy's jumping under pressure as Oscar Palmer's 3lb claim could be crucial if she makes mistakes
Early pace development - if Pepite De Saphir goes too conservatively it hands initiative to prominent trackers
Seasmoke's positioning turning for home as Benjamin Macey needs to find clear run from hold-up spot

races.paceDynamic: Independent Jimmy is withdrawn, leaving no natural front-runner in this field of prominent and hold-up horses. The Clonmel Kid and Hawkseye View will likely dispute early leadership from their prominent positions, creating a genuine pace battle through the first half of this 2m4f test. With Kingston Rock and Quickasican also keen early, the pace should be solid to strong, setting up perfectly for the hold-up horses Empty Nest and Bravethewaves to deliver their challenges late. This pace scenario strongly favours patient, hold-up runners who can exploit the inevitable weakening of those who've done the early donkey work.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If The Clonmel Kid and Hawkseye View go at it early with Kingston Rock joining in
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable over this trip, allowing the back markers to pick up the pieces in the final half-mile. Empty Nest and Bravethewaves get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners settle into a more measured rhythm after initial sparring
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical, allowing the class horses with good recent form to assert. Those with tactical speed from midfield positions can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Slow Early Fractions
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to make the running and they crawl through the early stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the home turn, favouring those with natural pace and less stamina-dependent profiles. The prominent runners can dictate and kick clear.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up and no clear pace emerges until very late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where positioning and racing luck matter more than running style. Experience and jockey skill become crucial factors.

watchPoints.text: Independent Jimmy is a non-runner, completely removing the expected front-runner and changing the entire pace dynamic of this race
The Clonmel Kid and Hawkseye View could engage in a pace duel that sets up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses behind them
Empty Nest has been running well in similar company and gets the ideal tactical setup if the pace unfolds as expected
Kingston Rock gets a 5lb claim and significant weight relief which could make him more competitive than recent form suggests
Bravethewaves has excellent course form at Newcastle and the hold-up style that should benefit from the likely pace scenario

races.paceDynamic: Camarrate is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the start, likely setting a comfortable gallop without early pressure. With only Abbey Scope, Lone Star, Achnamara and Toby Two Scoops showing prominent tendencies, the early pace should be sustainable rather than frantic. The bulk of the field comprises hold-up horses including Cher Tara, National Question, Noble George and Largy Meadow who will look to time their runs from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners and those who can position handily, as they can capitalize on the modest early gallop and have the tactical advantage over the large hold-up contingent fighting for room in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Camarrate sets an even gallop and the prominent horses track him comfortably
scenarios.body: The handy runners get first run on the large hold-up pack and can use their positional advantage to full effect. Abbey Scope and Toby Two Scoops are ideally placed to strike from prominent positions while the back markers struggle for clear runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Camarrate faces no serious early challenge and gets his own way completely
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate splits perfectly and prove hard to peg back despite his moderate topspeed rating. His solid recent form and lack of early pressure creates the perfect scenario for him to tough it out up front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too slow and National Question or Cher Tara produce their best turn of foot
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup with a dawdling pace allowing them to unleash superior finishing kicks. National Question's recent wins show he thrives when getting the right race setup from the back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Camarrate goes too fast early or gets challenged aggressively by the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable and the race falls apart in the final half-mile. This allows the patient hold-up horses to pick up the pieces as the early leaders weaken dramatically in the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: Camarrate must be monitored early as any strong challenge to his lead could set up a completely different race dynamic
The Final Brig and Diamond Trilogy both carry finishing weakness warnings and could struggle in the closing stages
Watch for Abbey Scope and Toby Two Scoops to position prominently early as they have the tactical advantage in this race shape
National Question needs the pace to develop slowly early to give his hold-up style the best chance
Long Time Listener represents a stable completely out of form with Tim Easterby showing 0 wins from 25 recent runners

races.paceDynamic: Hello Judge will control this from the front with no natural pace pressure, as Parisencore and Glory And Honour are the only prominent runners likely to track him early. The sustained tempo will suit those who can travel kindly in behind, with Special Rate and Geryville having time to organise their challenges from the rear. With minimal early speed and a lone leader setting his own fractions, this becomes a tactical affair where patient hold-up horses can time their runs perfectly. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can quicken late over a trip that demands stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Hello Judge sets uncontested fractions and the pace lacks bite throughout
scenarios.body: Special Rate and Geryville get the perfect scenario to unleash late kicks, with the patient tactics proving superior over this stamina-sapping trip. The lack of early pace allows the backmarkers to conserve energy for decisive late moves.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Hello Judge maintains a strong gallop and his rivals fail to mount serious challenges
scenarios.body: The leader's control of the race proves decisive as he dictates terms from pillar to post, with the chasers unable to reel him in. His recent form suggests he has the stamina to resist late challenges over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Parisencore or Glory And Honour press Hello Judge earlier than expected and create genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The increased tempo plays into the hands of those racing handily, with the prominent horses able to capitalise on a stronger pace that finds out the hold-up horses. This scenario rewards those positioned to strike turning for home.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the entire field goes to sleep early and Hello Judge sets pedestrian fractions with no one willing to challenge
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the horse with the best turn of foot wins regardless of running style. Pure speed rather than stamina becomes the decisive factor in an unexpectedly tactical affair.

watchPoints.text: Hello Judge's jumping under pressure if challenged late, given his recent unseating and pulled-up efforts when pressed
Glory And Honour's fitness levels after 190-day absence, particularly if the pace quickens in the final half-mile
Special Rate's position turning for home, as he needs to be within striking distance to utilise his proven finishing kick
How aggressively Alice Stevens rides Geryville early, as inexperienced claiming jockeys can sometimes get caught too far back
Whether Parisencore travels with his old enthusiasm early given the lengthy break and his advancing years

races.paceDynamic: Double Digits and Thank You Blue are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, creating an honest gallop from the outset. With both horses committed to leading, they'll likely set a solid tempo through the early stages before one attempts to kick clear approaching the final hurdle. The remaining four runners are all hold-up horses who will track this pace battle from behind. This race shape clearly favours the front runners, as they face no tactical pressure from prominent racers and can dictate terms against a field of hold-up horses who must make ground late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Duel Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Double Digits and Thank You Blue sustain their battle to the line
scenarios.body: The two leaders will have controlled the pace perfectly and one will prove strongest in the final furlong, with the hold-up horses unable to close the gap. Thank You Blue's recent winning form gives him the edge over Double Digits' longer absence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners go too hard early and tire
scenarios.body: The pace battle between the leaders will create perfect conditions for the hold-up horses to sweep past in the closing stages. Bust A Move and Filibustering have the class to capitalise if given a strong pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Double Digits Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Double Digits gets an uncontested lead while Thank You Blue struggles
scenarios.body: McMenamin will be able to dictate a slower pace that suits his mount's stamina, making the hold-up horses' task even harder. Double Digits' previous course form and front-running style will prove decisive in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Shock
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners make jumping errors or tactical mistakes
scenarios.body: The pace collapses completely, turning it into a sprint finish where class tells over running style. As Fast As Wind's recent consistency could pay dividends if the race falls apart tactically.

Double Digits needs monitoring for ring rustiness having been off 51 days, especially when asked to quicken
Bust A Move wearing headgear suggests connections are concerned about his attitude after long absence
As Fast As Wind has struggled on similar going recently with 0 wins from 15 runs, making him vulnerable
Filibustering's quick return after 12 days indicates connections are happy with his condition

races.paceDynamic: Dotties Promise will lead from the start with no obvious pace rival, setting a comfortable rhythm through the early stages. Lost Frequencies, Executive Producer and Hashtag Queen will sit prominent behind the leader, while Diamond Koda, Port Station and Dunkerque are all confirmed hold-up performers who will need the pace to develop. With only one natural leader and three hold-up horses, this creates a tactical race where the tempo may not be strong enough to set up the closers. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track Dotties Promise and kick when the pace lifts, as the hold-up horses may find insufficient pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Lost Frequencies or Executive Producer can sit second/third behind Dotties Promise and the pace stays steady
scenarios.body: The patient prominent runner gets first run on the leader turning for home while the hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the moderate gallop. Superior class tells when the race develops into a sprint from the last hurdle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Surprise Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Dotties Promise gets an uncontested lead and maintains energy for a long kick from three out
scenarios.body: The 67-rated leader exploits the tactical nature with Nathan Moscrop judging the fractions perfectly, holding off late challengers who left their run too late. The 7lb weight advantage proves crucial in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Collide
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway when Lost Frequencies or Executive Producer press Dotties Promise
scenarios.body: This creates the strong gallop that Diamond Koda, Port Station and Dunkerque need, allowing them to unleash their finishing kicks. The early pace-makers pay for their exertions as the closers sweep past in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Dotties Promise goes too slowly and the prominent trackers are caught napping turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle where fresh legs matter most, potentially suiting a hold-up horse with tactical speed. Jockey error in the early positioning becomes costly as the field bunches up.

watchPoints.text: Dotties Promise sets crawling pace through first mile - if fractions are too slow the hold-up horses will struggle to make impact
Lost Frequencies and Executive Producer both prominent runners - watch if they engage in early battle rather than tracking the leader patiently
Diamond Koda and Port Station may be taken too far back if pace is moderate - both need to be closer than usual turning for home
Nathan Moscrop on Dotties Promise - veteran jockey may judge fractions perfectly to steal this from front if others wait too long
Three claiming jockeys aboard Diamond Koda, Executive Producer and Hashtag Queen - tactical errors possible in slowly-run race
